label: Weak, dense hum (11% of tokens reach 0.1 of a small max) that rises on talk-based mental-health treatment and the writing around it: counselling, therapy sessions, psychiatrists, psychoanalysis, psychodynamic work, support groups where people talk through their problems (about 0.2-0.65); mental-health book outlines and speech therapy also lift it (inverse found 0.46-0.55). Physical medicine (surgery, dentistry, nursing, vets) hums at the 0.1-0.2 baseline. Lateness: plain 'too late' / 'ran late' stays near zero, BUT the feeders' late signal does carry through in the discovered-too-late construction ('noticed / realised / found out too late that ...', 0.2-0.45 peaking on ' late'), so 'lateness adds nothing' was too strong.

qc.label_under_test: Weak, dense hum (11% of tokens reach 0.1 of a small max) that rises on talk-based mental-health treatment: counselling and therapy sessions, psychiatrists, psychoanalysis, psychodynamic work, where people talk through their problems; speech therapy and the word 'talking' bump it a little. Symptom lists and CBT jargon, where the + pole takes over, stay near zero. Physical medicine (surgery, physio, pharmacy) hums at the 0.1-0.2 baseline. Lateness adds nothing: 'too late' scores like 'too early', and the feeders' foreign too/late/tan words (demasiado, zu spät, поздно) do not carry through, apart from a small bump on the headline 'Too Little too Late?'.
